verdict: Paid ads have been off 28 days; lead flow is at zero.
narrative: This period delivered zero paid leads and zero ad spend across all channels — your practice's entire digital presence ran on organic activity alone. Your Google Business Profile generated 232 actions (74 calls, 95 direction requests, 63 website clicks), but that organic activity is now declining, with GBP actions down 33.8% week-over-week and the last three days recording no actions at all. Search visibility followed the same pattern, with clicks dropping 69% week-over-week — consistent with the absence of paid support. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority, and attribution and reporting infrastructure is being resolved in parallel so the renewal decision is backed by clean data.
